name: tool-expanded-streaming
description: One Bash tool call that stays running for ~60s; its replace-updates every 0.25-1.1s carry the full output so far (growing to 362 lines), then it completes.
scenario: An expanded running tool card whose output keeps growing: re-render cost of a large, growing monospace log and stick-to-bottom behaviour (requirement 16.1 item 10).

item.text: Run the soak test and let me watch the output as it goes.
I'll keep the output open while it runs.
